scientific_integrity: All five negative coefficients are exact rational numbers and all 252 orbit classes have complete rational coefficient vectors in coefficients.csv; standard-library verify.py recreates the entire certificate. Finite dimensional enumeration is not an argument for any n beyond fourteen. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claims cover only Minkowski sums of exactly two nontrivial hypersimplices of ambient dimension at most fourteen. The positivity cutoff is a rigorously exhaustive finite calculation via an explicit integer formula and exact rational interpolation, not a general-dimension closed positivity identity. One of the five critical examples was published previously. Historical priority beyond inspected sources remains provisional.
title: The first Ehrhart nonpositive sums of two hypersimplices: an exact dimension cutoff
